					}

								check_variable = { num_owned_states > zin_d_most }
							}

					}

					}

	zin_deep_the_sun_crown_cld = {
		icon = zin_deep_crown_radiant
		allowed = {
			always = yes
		}
		visible = {
			original_tag = CLD
			zin_deep_holds_hearth_stone = yes
			NOT = {
				has_global_flag = zin_deep_sun_crown_formed
			}
			has_country_flag = zin_deep_sun_crown_route
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = zin_deep_tt_three_finds
				check_variable = { zin_deep_finds_made > 2.99 }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = zin_deep_tt_three_names
				has_country_flag = zin_deep_three_names
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = zin_deep_tt_neck_road
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						country_exists = HOR
					}
					is_in_faction_with = HOR
					HOR = {
						is_subject_of = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 150
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = zin_deep_the_sun_crown_tt
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_deep_grain_for_clans days = 365 }
			hidden_effect = {
				set_cosmetic_tag = zin_cosmetic_heulfaenn
				set_global_flag = zin_deep_sun_crown_formed
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_sun_crown
				add_ideas = zin_deep_sun_crown_spirit
				save_event_target_as = zin_deep_claimant
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.zin_deep_free_steadings_states
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								is_core_of = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
							}
						}
						add_state_claim = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = FEA
					}
					FEA = {
						country_event = { id = zin_deep.263 }
					}
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.264 }
				every_neighbor_country = {
					country_event = { id = zin_deep.264 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_war = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = { has_political_power > 75 }
			}
		}
	}
